UpdateStageName: Download pinned Ubuntu x64 CPU runtime
Extract runtime, create API key, check dependencies
UpdateSourceArgs:
-c 'set -eu
cd ./yoda-llm/serverfiles
stage=$(mktemp -d ./extract.XXXXXX)
tar -xzf runtime.tar.gz -C "$stage"
server=$(find "$stage" -type f -name llama-server -print -quit)
test -n "$server"
bindir=$(dirname "$server")
cp -a "$bindir/." .
chmod +x ./llama-server
mkdir -p cache
if [ ! -s api-key.txt ]; then
  umask 077
  od -An -N32 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d '\'' \n'\'' > api-key.txt
  printf '\''\n'\'' >> api-key.txt
fi
./llama-server --version
printf '\''Runtime installed. API key is in serverfiles/api-key.txt; model downloads on first start.\n'\''
'
